ov: شقوقهو فيلم مغربيّ صدرَ عام 2009 من إخراج وكتابة هشام عيوش.
plotEn: In the city of Tangier three people on the margins of society looking for love and deliverance will come together and find love with one another: Abdelsellem, a man who breaks out of prison, Noureddine, his best friend, and Marcela, a Brazilian fantasist, excessive and suicidal.
